query: (probiotic OR synbiotic OR Lactobacillus OR Bifidobacterium OR Lactiplantibacillus) AND (obesity OR overweight OR "body weight" OR BMI OR "body fat" OR adiposity) AND (16S OR metagenom* OR shotgun OR microbiota OR microbiome) AND (randomi* OR placebo OR intervention OR trial) AND NOT (PUB_TYPE:"review-article" OR PUB_TYPE:"review")
relevance_filter: kept only studies whose title/abstract show an adiposity outcome AND an interventional design, excluding cross-sectional and infant/animal populations
method: EuropePMC search + abstract relevance gate + per-article datalinks API
limitation: Datalinks presence does not guarantee per-subject paired baseline+outcome design; each candidate requires manual confirmation. Studies without a deposit are not IPD-usable from public data.
